non_urf_scientific_claim: A simple resistor behaves approximately linearly under Ohm's law in a small fixed observation set.
bounded_claim: For the listed fixed observations only, every inferred resistance value V/I lies within 0.5 percent of the declared 1000 ohm nominal resistance.
non_claim_boundary: Does not claim universal Ohm's law.
Does not validate any physical instrument.
Does not establish material linearity outside the listed observations.
Does not infer causation from the fixed dataset.
Does not extend beyond the declared nominal resistance and tolerance check.
copy_sentence: Copy this pattern for your own claim.
